# Over the Rainbow - Pet Memorial Project

## Project Overview
This is a pet memorial website that allows users to create and share tributes for beloved pets.

## Project Structure
- `index.html` - Main landing page
- `tribute-wall.html` - Display wall for pet tributes
- `memorial-builder.html` - Tool to create new pet memorials
- `dedication.html` - Dedication pages for pets
- `shop.html` - Shop/merchandise page
- `donate.html` - Donation page
- `support.html` - Support/help page
- `signup.html` - User registration
- `js/` - JavaScript files
  - `main.js` - Core functionality
  - `builder.js` - Memorial builder logic
  - `tribute.js` - Tribute display and management
  - `shop.js` - Shop functionality
- `data/` - Data storage
  - `memories.json` - User memories/tributes
  - `tributes.json` - Tribute data
- `css/` - Stylesheets
  - `styles.css` - Main styles

## Code Style & Guidelines
- Use semantic HTML5 elements
- Keep CSS organized and use classes for styling
- JavaScript should follow ES6+ standards
- Ensure accessibility (WCAG 2.1 AA standards)
- Add comments for complex logic

## Key Features to Maintain
- Memorial creation and customization
- Tribute wall display
- User testimonials and stories
- Donation functionality
- Shop integration
- Responsive design for mobile, tablet, and desktop

## Testing
- Test across different browsers
- Verify responsive design
- Check accessibility with screen readers
- Test all forms and data submission

## Tone & Brand Voice
- Respectful and compassionate
- Celebratory of pet lives and memories
- Inclusive and welcoming
- Professional yet warm
